mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations ( user_id, room_id, accommodation_id, check_in_date, check_out_date, guest_count, total_price, status, payment_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{roomId}, #{accommodationId}, #{checkInDate}, #{checkOutDate}, #{guestCount}, #{totalPrice}, #{status}, #{paymentStatus}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.username AS user_name, u.email AS user_email, u.phone AS user_phone, rm.name AS room_name, a.title AS accommodation_title, a.accommodation_id, h.business_name as host_business_name, DATEDIFF(r.check_out_date, r.check_in_date) AS nights FROM reservations r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id JOIN rooms rm ON r.room_id = rm.room_id JOIN accommodations a ON rm.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id JOIN hosts h ON a.host_id = h.host_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT r.* FROM reservations r JOIN rooms rm ON r.room_id = rm.room_id JOIN accommodations a ON rm.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id WHERE a.host_id = #{hostId}

SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE (check_in_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}) OR (check_out_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}) OR (check_in_date <= #{startDate} AND check_out_date >= #{endDate})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations ( user_id, room_id, accommodation_id, merchant_uid, check_in_date, check_out_date, guest_count, total_price, status, payment_status, special_requests, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{roomId}, #{accommodationId}, #{merchantUid}, #{checkInDate}, #{checkOutDate}, #{guestCount}, #{totalPrice}, #{status}, #{paymentStatus}, #{specialRequests}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.username AS user_name, u.email AS user_email, u.phone AS user_phone, rm.name AS room_name, a.title AS accommodation_title, r.accommodation_id, h.business_name as host_business_name, DATEDIFF(r.check_out_date, r.check_in_date) AS nights FROM reservations r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN rooms rm ON r.room_id = rm.room_id LEFT JOIN accommodations a ON r.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id LEFT JOIN hosts h ON a.host_id = h.host_id WHERE r.merchant_uid = #{merchantUid} AND r.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
mapper.update: UPDATE reservations SET status = #{reservationStatus}, payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE merchant_uid = #{merchantUid} AND (status != #{reservationStatus} OR payment_status != #{paymentStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'

SELECT r.*, u.username AS user_name, u.email AS user_email, u.phone AS user_phone, rm.name AS room_name, a.title AS accommodation_title, r.accommodation_id, h.business_name as host_business_name, DATEDIFF(r.check_out_date, r.check_in_date) AS nights FROM reservations r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN rooms rm ON r.room_id = rm.room_id LEFT JOIN accommodations a ON r.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id LEFT JOIN hosts h ON a.host_id = h.host_id WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND r.user_id = #{userId}
